         assert d['edition_count'] == 4
         assert d['ebook_count_i'] == 3
 
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_public_edition_takes_priority_over_lending_and_printdisabled(self):
+        w = make_work()
+        update_work.data_provider = FakeDataProvider(
+            [
+                w,
+                make_edition(
+                    w, key='/books/OL10M', ocaid='loan',
+                    _ia_meta={'collection': ['lendinglibrary', 'library']},
+                ),
+                make_edition(
+                    w, key='/books/OL11M', ocaid='disabled1',
+                    _ia_meta={'collection': ['printdisabled', 'library']},
+                ),
+                make_edition(
+                    w, key='/books/OL12M', ocaid='public',
+                    _ia_meta={'collection': ['americana']},
+                ),
+                make_edition(
+                    w, key='/books/OL13M', ocaid='disabled2',
+                    _ia_meta={'collection': ['printdisabled', 'inlibrary']},
+                ),
+            ]
+        )
+
+        d = await build_data(w)
+        assert d['has_fulltext'] is True
+        assert d['public_scan_b'] is True
+        assert d['lending_edition_s'] == 'OL12M'
+        assert d['lending_identifier_s'] == 'public'
+        assert sss(d['printdisabled_s']) == ['OL11M', 'OL13M']
+        assert set(d['ia']) == {'loan', 'disabled1', 'public', 'disabled2'}
+        assert sss(d['ia_collection_s']) == [
+            'americana', 'inlibrary', 'lendinglibrary', 'library', 'printdisabled'
+        ]
+
     @pytest.mark.asyncio
     async def test_subjects(self):
         w = make_work(subjects=["a", "b c"])
